Name: Pashur, Son of Malchiah
Summary: Pashur, son of Malchiah, was sent by Zedekiah to ask Jeremiah whether God would deal with Babylon, and later joined the princes who demanded Jeremiah's death and had him cast into Malchiah's dungeon. He is a different man from Pashur son of Immer.
KeyStory: Zedekiah sent Pashur son of Malchiah to enquire of the Lord about Nebuchadnezzar's war, and Jeremiah answered that the city would be given into Babylon's hand.
RelatedPeople: Zedekiah, King of Judah; Jeremiah; Gedaliah, Son of Pashur
LifeLesson: Asking God's counsel while planning to kill his messenger shows the question was never honest.
